blocks.content:
Built-in Hooks
↓
Combine them
↓
Custom Hook
↓
Reusable React logic
↓
Multiple components
The key idea is not "I need to create hooks everywhere."
It's:
When multiple components need the same React-related logic, extract that logic into a custom Hook.
